source.author: verg
source.text: Hic Nomadum genus et discinctos Mulciber Afros, hic Lelegas Carasque sagittiferosque Gelonos finxerat; Euphrates ibat iam mollior undis, extremique hominum Morini, Rhenusque bicornis, indomitique Dahae, et pontem indignatus Araxes.
source.text_original: Hic Nomadum genus et discinctos Mulciber Afros, / hic Lelegas Carasque sagittiferosque Gelonos / finxerat; Euphrates ibat iam mollior undis, / extremique hominum Morini, Rhenusque bicornis, / indomitique Dahae, et pontem indignatus Araxes.
source.text_english: Here Vulcan had shaped the race of the Nomads and the loosely girded Africans, here the Leleges, the Carians, and the arrow-bearing Geloni; the Euphrates was already flowing more gently in its waves, and the Morini at the edge of the world, and the two-horned Rhine, and the untamed Dahae, and Araxes, indignant at a bridge.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Mogontiacus, nobilis quondam ciuitas, capta atque subuersa est et in ecclesia multa hominum milia trucidata, Uangiones longa obsidione finiti, Remorum urbs praepotens, Ambiani, Atrabatae extremique hominum Morini, Tornacus, Nemetae, Argentoratus translatae in Germaniam, Aquitaniae Nouemque populorum, Lugdunensis et Narbonensis prouinciae praeter paucas urbes cuncta populata sunt, quas et ipsas foris gladius, intus uastat fames.
reuse.text_original: Mogontiacus, nobilis quondam ciuitas, capta atque subuersa est et in ecclesia multa hominum milia trucidata, Uangiones longa obsidione finiti, Remorum urbs praepotens, Ambiani, Atrabatae extremique hominum Morini, Tornacus, Nemetae, Argentoratus translatae in Germaniam, Aquitaniae Nouemque populorum, Lugdunensis et Narbonensis prouinciae praeter paucas urbes cuncta populata sunt, quas et ipsas foris gladius, intus uastat fames.
reuse.text_english: Mogontiacus, once a noble city, has been captured and overthrown, and in the church many thousands of people have been slaughtered; the Uangiones are brought to ruin by a long siege; the powerful city of the Remi, the Ambiani, the Atrabatae, and the Morini, the farthest of men, Tornacus, Nemetae, Argentoratus, transferred into Germany; in Aquitania and the province of the Nine Peoples, and of Lugdunensis and Narbonensis, everything has been ravaged except for a few cities, and even these are devastated by the sword without and by famine within.
